instruction: Name the artist most recommended to me on Spotify.
notes: Read-only question task: the goal demands no database changes, only retrieval of the artist name and task completion with it as the answer. The aggregation ('most recommended') cannot be computed in STRIPS, so the problem uses one abstract song object standing for the whole recommendation list and one artist object (top-artist) linked by the static facts song-by/most-recommended; at runtime the agent paginates show_recommendations, calls show_song for each song_id, counts artist ids, and picks the most frequent one before calling show_artist. Pagination (page_index) is not modeled as a PDDL parameter. show_profile is required before login because the reference solution takes the username (supervisor email) from it. The person object kyle-moore is declared for completeness but is not consumed by any API.
